ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Bajaj Finance Limited reported a strong provisional Q2 FY27 performance, driven by a 26.5% year-over-year growth in Assets Under Management (AUM) to approximately ₹584,750 crore and a significant expansion of its customer franchise to 128.85 million. While new loans booked increased by 11%, this year-over-year comparison is explicitly noted as not directly comparable due to the prior year's early festival season onset, a key factor impacting interpretation. The figures are provisional and subject to audit review, a standard disclosure but a material qualifier.
